SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt (Class Reader), part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What issues in the society are addressed by stories? 2. How can one derive lessons from a short story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt (Class Reader) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner shows concerted attention to detail when forming adverbs from adjectives .

• Critical thinking is developed as the learner cultivates the skills of reasoning when using adverbs in sentences.

Values:
Responsibility is promoted as the learner demonstrates accountabilty when selecting adverbs from digital devices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Decision making is achieved as the learner makes decisions on adverbs to use in speech and writing.

Link to other subjects:

Word formation is relevant in vocabulary buiding skills in Kiswahili.
